comment: The complete set of llama.cpp source changes of the HIP route, in the order they apply on the base.
build-llama-patched.ps1 checks every marker and applies the missing patches in this order with -ApplyPatches.
test-llama-build-options.ps1 checks that every patch file of this directory is in the list, and, given an
upstream checkout, that the whole list applies on the base in this order. The marker of each entry is a string
that the patch adds to the file and that the base does not hold, so the marker, not the patch file, is the
evidence that a change is in. The llama-rdna1-* entries are ports of the MIT llama.cpp patches of
https://github.com/akandr/bc250-rocm (patches/llamacpp); each has its own .md with the source and the rebase notes.

patches.what: no device printf in the HIP kernels
gfx1013 in the device-side RDNA1 list
the RDNA1 dp4a assembly behind a macro
RDNA1 matrix-vector table, v_sad_u8 sums and the float-activation matvec
RDNA1 prefill through a packed-fp16 tile GEMM
the packed-fp16 GEMM with a 64-column tile
